slides.title: 從例子中學會判斷
slides.text:
從例子中學會判斷
機器學習：資料 → 模型 → 預測
1 收集例子
2 標上答案
3 訓練模型
4 預測新資料
5 檢驗成效
分類：是哪一類？
迴歸：會是多少？
異常偵測：哪裡不尋常？
換了資料或情境，仍要重新驗證
slides.layout: Top five-stage curved pipeline with records, labeled sample, small neural network, prediction card, held-out evaluation magnifying glass. Bottom three blue teal orange panels for classification cell icons, regression numeric chart, anomaly outlier dot. Instructor at lower-left guides toward panels. Training and evaluation are visibly separate; evaluation uses unseen examples.
slides.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create one finished classroom infographic slide, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 or higher. Image 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their existing infographic style closely: cream-white background with soft blue/teal/orange glow, giant bold navy Traditional Chinese headline, chunky rounded colored headers, white pill labels, friendly thick-outline cartoon illustrations, numbered circles, clear arrows and yellow emphasis strokes. Image 3 is CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE: Yang is the real instructor himself, not a generic mascot. Preserve his black hair, rectangular glasses, navy shirt, recognizable face. Use him once as a guide near the lower-left looking toward the educational content on his right. No institution branding. Projector legibility: short exact text, very large glyphs, generous spacing, no extra tiny text, no watermark. Preserve style reference rather than inventing a new design. All Chinese Traditional, Taiwan usage. Exact visible text (include all, no additional prose):

slides.title: 打磚塊：AI 只學預測落點
slides.text:
打磚塊：AI 只學預測落點
它不聊天，只預測一個數字
特徵：球的位置與方向
標籤：實際落點
訓練：依誤差修正
預測：下一球落在哪？
評估：誤差與接球率
部署：匯入已訓練模型
這是「迴歸」：輸出落點位置
slides.layout: Large colorful brick-breaker game in center with ball descending, dotted path, horizontal paddle, blue prediction triangle; six labeled callout cards surrounding it with arrows. Distinguish actual landing position from predicted landing position. Instructor thinking at lower-left. Bottom orange takeaway.
